description: Public merge_small_color_regions contract: strict area threshold, shared-boundary-length winner, and unpainted boundary blocking.

mutants.description: Treat an equal-area component as small; the threshold-6 control must remain unchanged under the strict source contract.
Forget repeated boundary lengths for one neighboring color; the central component must choose color 2 from lengths 3+4 over color 1 length 5.
Allow the -1 unpainted sentinel to vote; all-unpainted neighbors must leave the central color unchanged.
Select the smallest shared boundary instead of the strongest; the 3+4 versus 5 geometry must reject that result.
